name: Feng Hua
source:
A stranger that broke into Ophelia's house on the 16th of September.

Both her attire and behaviour are rather eccentric and her eyes are full of sorrow and hatred.

She has a compulsion of looking at her watch and when she does, she also mumbles. Her timepiece is a black-toned platinum Luna Mundi decorated with the Big Dipper.
